evidence.reason: render_units collects every recursive systemd file whose basename starts with crq- (lines 683-684) but writes each rendered result to output / source.name (line 707). If the target contains both crq-repair.service and extra/crq-repair.service, both templates have the same output basename, so the second write silently overwrites the first while duplicate paths are returned. Rejecting duplicate basenames before writing is a routine correctness fix.
